decisions.reason: Designating a new working file does not change the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
The working-file designation does not change the established copyediting goals, sentence-clarity rule, or meaning-preservation rule.
The source changes the authoritative manuscript file but does not alter any image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirement.
The working-file designation does not resolve or modify the cover design, trim size, or preferred cover visual.
The source does not change the required back matter or author lines.
Selecting a working manuscript file does not change the requested publishing-process, prerequisite, or copyright guidance.
The source neither resumes the deferred spacing requirement nor changes its paragraph-spacing or page-density values.
The working-file designation does not change the italic styling required for the Mama's Hot Take text.
The source does not change the permitted image source, suitability review, or selection criteria.
The source does not alter chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, references, or selected images.
The manuscript working-file choice does not resume or modify the deferred KDP assistance workflow.
The source does not change the Chapter 18 subtitle treatment or heading-consistency requirements.
